title: Envelope
$comment: The envelope is not itself transmitted; its chunks are (§5.5). AUTHORED object (§5.1): produced by an actor and validated against this schema. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

profile.description: Resolution profile identifier (§9). A release claiming the `document` extension (§16.5) widens this enum.

resolutionProof.description: A proof by reference (§5.2, D-26): the hash, and the canonical location its manifest is dereferenced at. The manifest is never carried in-band.

oneOf.description: A structured locator naming one HCS message (§5.2). Not an HRL: the HCS-1 HRL grammar names files, not messages.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

uri.description: The manifest’s canonical location. Null until `send` publishes the manifest (§6.2, §6.4 step 2).

nonce.description: 16 bytes, fresh per envelope, from a cryptographically secure source (§7.2).

aad.description: The AAD bytes: canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of {p, v, l, lane, rp, nc} — exactly those key names (§7.2, D-127).

aadHash.description: SHA-256 over `aad`; the envelope identifier (§7.2). T-P1-4 is the court: spec/vectors/aad.json.

keyEpoch.description: The recipient key epoch sealed against. MUST equal the keyEpoch the bound resolution yielded (§11.4, T-P1-10).

ephemeralPub.description: The sender’s ephemeral X25519 public key; HPKE `enc` (§7.3). Identifies nothing about the sender.

schemaRef.description: HCS-13 version-pinned locator (§5.11, D-90). The unpinned form is never a schemaRef.
